about_the_game:
Fateful Night is a story-driven psychological horror game about four college students searching for a thrill.

Story:

You’ll experience the events through the eyes of Jim, one of the students. Along with his girlfriend and friends, he heads to an abandoned house deep in the forest — a place suggested by one of his friends, Ryan. The police had no record of the house, and the group decided to explore it before anyone else.

Gameplay:

The game is a narrative walking simulator focused on atmosphere, tension, and interaction with the characters.
Most of the gameplay centers around dialogue and the choices you make while interacting with others. Every character responds to your words and actions, and key decisions can affect the story and the fate of your friends.

Will you all make it back alive, or will some of you never reach your next exam?
Everything will be decided on this fateful night.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10, Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i3 or AMD Ryzen™ 3
  • Memory: 6 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 650 Ti, 2 GB | AMD Radeon R7 360, 2 GB
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10, Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i5 or AMD Ryzen™ 5
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® GTX 1060 or AMD Radeon™ RX 480
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 5 GB available space

short_description: Jim and his three friends head to an abandoned house in the forest, hoping to escape the pressure of upcoming exams and break free from their mundane routine. But none of them realizes that this night will prove to be fateful.
supported_languages: English, Russian, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Simplified Chinese, Korean, Polish, Turkish, Japanese, Portuguese - Brazil
